svg.title: Apache Spark pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Three-level pipeline architecture in Apache Spark: RDD transformation DAG pipeline, SQL Catalyst optimizer batch pipeline (Analysis to Code Generation), and DAGScheduler physical stage pipeline submitting TaskSets to TaskSchedulerImpl.
svg.text: Pipeline 1 — RDD lazy DAG pipeline · RDD.scala

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Spark read source data into an RDD?')
sendPrompt('How does map work as a pipeline filter in Spark RDDs?')
sendPrompt('How does filter work as a pipeline stage in Spark?')
sendPrompt('How does flatMap work in the RDD pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does groupByKey trigger a shuffle stage boundary?')

svg.text: Transformations are lazy — build a DAG of filters; evaluated only at an action (collect / save)
Pipeline 2 — SQL Catalyst optimizer · RuleExecutor.scala — ordered Batch pipeline to fixpoint

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Analysis phase do in the Catalyst optimizer?')
sendPrompt('What rules run in the Optimization batch of the Catalyst pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What happens during Physical Planning in Catalyst?')
sendPrompt('What does whole-stage code generation do in Spark?')

svg.text: Each Batch: named stage · Rule filters applied iteratively until fixpoint · output is optimized physical plan
Pipeline 3 — DAGScheduler physical stage pipeline · DAGScheduler.scala

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does DAGScheduler create Stage 1 from the RDD DAG?')
sendPrompt('How does Stage 2 read shuffle data from Stage 1?')
sendPrompt('How many stages can a Spark job have?')
sendPrompt('How does DAGScheduler submit a TaskSet to TaskSchedulerImpl?')

svg.text: Stages cut at shuffle boundaries · each submitted as a TaskSet to TaskSchedulerImpl

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does TaskSchedulerImpl dispatch tasks to executors?')
g.text: Dispatch tasks to worker JVMs · results flow back through the pipeline

svg.text: Filter taxonomy — every stage reads input, transforms, writes output

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What RDD transformation filters exist in Spark?')
